source: Warpforge Offline Rulebook 1.5 (unofficial fan rulebook), keyword table; wording shortened and adapted to the digital game

keywords.name: Agenda
keywords.text: An action the unit can take instead of attacking: it triggers the card's effect.

keywords.name: Ambush
keywords.text: Played face down. If it is damaged before your next turn it is revealed with no effect; if it is not, it is revealed and its effect triggers.

keywords.name: Armour X
keywords.text: All damage this unit takes is reduced by X, to a minimum of 1.

keywords.name: Artifice
keywords.text: Triggers an extra effect each time you play a stratagem.

keywords.name: Backlash
keywords.text: Triggers an effect when this unit dies.

keywords.name: Blast X
keywords.text: When it attacks, it also deals X damage to the units next to the target.

keywords.name: Blind
keywords.text: A condition: the unit's ranged attack is 0 while it is blind.

keywords.name: Blood Thirst
keywords.text: Can attack up to twice during your turn.

keywords.name: Camouflage
keywords.text: Cannot be targeted by enemy stratagems and effects until it has attacked.

keywords.name: Can't Attack
keywords.text: Can never attack enemy units.

keywords.name: Codex
keywords.text: Triggers an effect when your energy reaches 0.

keywords.name: Companion X
keywords.text: When played from your hand, you may also play up to X copies of the troop named as its companion.

keywords.name: Concussion
keywords.text: Units this unit attacks become stunned.

keywords.name: Cruelty
keywords.text: Triggers an effect when an enemy unit is damaged but not destroyed during your turn.

keywords.name: Dark Pacts
keywords.text: Grants one of four buffs. Blood: +2 melee and Vanguard. Excess: +2 melee and +2 ranged. Fate: +2 health and Camouflage. Resilience: +1 health and Regeneration.

keywords.name: Destroyer
keywords.text: Always attacks a unit it can destroy before any other unit.

keywords.name: Duty
keywords.text: A one-time action used instead of attacking. Other card effects can reload it so it can be used again.

keywords.name: Ecstasy X
keywords.text: Triggers an effect when this unit's health drops to X or less without it dying.

keywords.name: Ephemeral
keywords.text: If this card is still in your hand at the end of the turn, it is removed.

keywords.name: Faith
keywords.text: Triggers an effect once your total Faith has reached the amount shown.

keywords.name: Fast
keywords.text: Can attack any enemy unit on the turn it is played.

keywords.name: Ferocity
keywords.text: A fast action used instead of attacking: the unit attacks, the effect triggers, then the unit is shuffled back into your deck.

keywords.name: Flank
keywords.text: Can attack enemy troops (not the warlord) on the turn it is played.

keywords.name: Flying
keywords.text: Cannot be targeted by melee attacks, except from other units with Flying.

keywords.name: Hunt Mark
keywords.text: Stacks. When an enemy troop with Hunt Marks is destroyed, the enemy warlord takes damage and your warlord heals, both equal to the number of marks it had.

keywords.name: Invulnerable
keywords.text: Cannot be damaged or destroyed.

keywords.name: Long Range
keywords.text: Takes no damage back when it makes a ranged attack. Lost once this unit has been attacked.

keywords.name: Markerlight X
keywords.text: A condition: the unit takes X extra damage from ranged attacks. All Markerlight is removed after it takes ranged damage.

keywords.name: Mob
keywords.text: Triggers an effect after a friendly troop makes a melee attack.

keywords.name: Oath X
keywords.text: When the troop is deployed you may pay X extra energy to trigger its effect.

keywords.name: Pack
keywords.text: +1 melee and +1 ranged for each friendly troop in play.

keywords.name: Penitence
keywords.text: Triggers an effect when this unit is damaged but not destroyed.

keywords.name: Pindown
keywords.text: A condition: the unit cannot make melee attacks.

keywords.name: Pray
keywords.text: A slow action used instead of attacking (Adepta Sororitas).

keywords.name: Quest
keywords.text: For every 3 Quest you gain, a Secret is added to your deck and the deck is shuffled.

keywords.name: Rally
keywords.text: Triggers an effect when the card is deployed from your hand.

keywords.name: Regeneration X
keywords.text: Heals X at the end of every turn.

keywords.name: Regiment
keywords.text: Triggers an effect when another friendly unit makes a ranged attack.

keywords.name: Remnant
keywords.text: When this troop dies it stays on the board as a Remnant. A Remnant is destroyed when it takes damage, or at the end of its controller's turn.

keywords.name: Sabotage
keywords.text: Creates a sabotage card in the opponent's hand.

keywords.name: Sentry X
keywords.text: Deals X damage to a unit that attacks it, before the attack resolves as normal.

keywords.name: Shield
keywords.text: Prevents the next damage this unit would take, then the Shield is lost.

keywords.name: Shuriken X
keywords.text: When it attacks, it first deals X extra damage to the target, then the attack resolves.

keywords.name: Slay
keywords.text: Triggers an effect after this unit attacks and destroys a unit, if it survives.

keywords.name: Sniper
keywords.text: If its ranged attack would destroy the target, the target deals no damage back.

keywords.name: Spirit Stone
keywords.text: A token left when an Aeldari unit with Waystone dies. It is destroyed when it takes damage. You collect it during your turn; abilities spend collected stones.

keywords.name: Stealth
keywords.text: Cannot be targeted at all for one turn, or until this unit attacks.

keywords.name: Stimulation
keywords.text: When this unit is targeted by a stratagem, its effect triggers before the stratagem resolves.

keywords.name: Stomp
keywords.text: When it attacks, damage beyond what destroys the target hits a random enemy next to the target.

keywords.name: Strike
keywords.text: Triggers an effect after this unit attacks, if it survives.

keywords.name: Stun
keywords.text: A condition: the unit cannot act at all while stunned.

keywords.name: Swarm
keywords.text: When played to the left of a troop with the same name, the two combine into one troop with their attack and health added together.

keywords.name: Synapse
keywords.text: When targeted by a friendly stratagem, the stratagem's effect is repeated on the adjacent troops or units.

keywords.name: Talent
keywords.text: Creates an Ephemeral stratagem in your hand at the start of your turn.

keywords.name: Teleport
keywords.text: Triggers an effect if the card is played on the same turn it was drawn.

keywords.name: Tide X
keywords.text: When played from your hand, you can play up to X more copies this turn, each at the same energy cost.

keywords.name: Unstable
keywords.text: When this unit dies it deals 1 to 3 damage to a random unit.

keywords.name: Uprising
keywords.text: Triggers an effect each time another troop is deployed after it on the turn it was deployed.

keywords.name: Vanguard
keywords.text: While it is in play, other friendly units cannot be targeted by attacks.

keywords.name: Vulnerable X
keywords.text: A condition: the unit takes X extra damage whenever it is damaged.

keywords.name: Waystone
keywords.text: When this unit dies it leaves a Spirit Stone.
